# möbius Gateway 0.15.18

Chats can be reassigned to another Bot while preserving their identity, workspace, transcript, and catalog settings. The gateway loads the target Bot through its existing runtime replacement path, rejects active work and voice calls, and restores the original owner if startup fails.

Runtime replacement checks are shared by reassignment and folder attachment. Includes the signed and notarized Mac companion. Protocol 76 requires matching clients; checkpoint format 14 is unchanged and existing conversations need no conversion. Packages preserve LICENSE and NOTICE.
